title: Rolling Stone COMPASS road-bike race-use review
notes: The 2016 exact-model review identifies COMPASS, Japanese Toray UD carbon, BB86, tapered head tube, internal routing and mechanical/Shimano Di2/Campagnolo EPS compatibility. It measured the frame at 1,060 g and fork at 385 g. After race use, the author described the frame as noticeably harsh with reduced comfort while finding its strength sufficient; this is a specific independent ride assessment, not a controlled numeric stiffness test.
